name: Origin Dollar Vault mintMultiple reentrancy
summary: VaultCore.mintMultiple() skipped the supported-asset check that mint() performed, so the attacker passed a self-controlled fake stablecoin whose transferFrom re-entered the vault and triggered a rebase between the first mint's asset transfer and its OUSD supply increase, minting more OUSD than the vault held in assets.
notes: Campaign: the attacker contract's follow-up redeem() calls and OUSD sales into the Uniswap and Sushi OUSD/USDT pools within the next hour, which turned the unbacked OUSD minted in the anchor into vault and pool assets; its collect() transfers to the EOA are not listed.

Victims are the Vault, its four strategies (with the Compound, Aave and Curve pools they withdrew from netted in) and the two OUSD/USDT pools. aDAI and 3Crv burns are dropped as receipts. DAI is net of the 942,688.56 DAI the attacker deposited in the anchor and redeemed later (its own round trip, not victim loss).
